oobe.subtitle: Let's set up your blog system
oobe.step1LongDesc: We'll automatically detect PHP version, required extensions, and directory permissions to ensure your server meets Rosetta's minimum requirements.
oobe.step2Desc: Fill in your database connection info
oobe.step2LongDesc: Rosetta supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Prepare an empty database with a user that has read/write privileges — the installer will create all tables automatically.
oobe.step3Desc: Configure site info and the admin account
oobe.step3LongDesc: Enter your site name, description, default language, and the admin credentials for logging into the dashboard. These can be changed later in settings.
oobe.step4LongDesc: Review the summary and click "Start Installation". The whole process usually takes under a minute: migrations, config file generation, and default data seeding will run in sequence.
oobe.adminNameDesc: Letters, numbers and underscores only, 3-20 characters
oobe.adminPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 chars with uppercase, lowercase and digits
oobe.siteDescriptionPlaceholder: A short one-liner about your blog
oobe.completeDesc: Please review the details below before starting. Do not close or refresh the page during installation.

about.title: About
about.desc: About the author behind this site, the tech stack, and everything.
about.bioP1: Hi, I'm the maintainer behind Rosetta. I write product code by day, hack on open-source projects by night, and wander around with a camera on weekends. This blog is where I keep engineering notes, reading notes, and bits of life — a simple place for thoughts to leave footprints.
about.bioP2: My focus is mainly on Web frontend architecture, developer experience, and toolchains that just feel good to use. Minimalism is my taste — I seek balance through restraint, both in code and in design.
about.bioP3: If anything here resonates with you, feel free to drop a note in the guestbook, or reach out via email or social links below. Link exchanges are always welcome — let's keep the indie web woven together.
about.motto: Stay hungry, stay foolish. Write code, write life.
about.techStackDesc: Core technologies and tools powering this site and my daily work
about.buyMeCoffeeDesc: If any article or code here helped you, consider supporting me through the links below. A like, comment, or share is already the best coffee I could ask for.
